title: Constructible algebraic-closure scalar restriction lies in the finite-field weak Serre coproduct heart
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite intermediate coefficient field, Lambda isomorphic as a condensed commutative ring to the finite-subextension-valued algebraic closure, X any qcqs scheme, and M a finite constant-model constructible Lambda_X module [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Restrict M along E -> Omega -> Lambda, where the second map is the inverse of the specified isomorphism. The result belongs to the weak Serre class closed under Type (u+1)-indexed coproducts generated by the finite constant-model constructible E_X modules. There is no properness, dimension, characteristic, or Noetherian hypothesis.

source.place: Finite coefficient descent of lisse modules, combined with the coefficient-basis coproduct and finite open-closed reconstruction; agent-formulated restriction lemma.

proof.text: Finite field restriction preserves lisse finite free local models: use the continuous finite coefficient basis on the point, pull it to the scheme, and flatten a finite biproduct of finite free modules. Such lisse modules have finite constant local models and the trivial constructible stratification.

On a qcqs scheme descend a lisse algebraic-closure module to a finite field F. Enlarge F to its compositum with E. The scalar-basis unit comparison identifies its restricted scalar extension with a coproduct of copies of its F-model. Restrict to E, preserving this coproduct, and use Step 1 to put every term in the constructible weak Serre coproduct class. Coefficient-extension transitivity identifies the resulting vertex with the desired restriction.

Refine the finite constant-model stratification to a finite qcqs open-closed tree whose nonempty leaves have lisse restrictions. Empty leaves are zero. Each branch functor preserves constructible models by the lattice-tree reconstruction theorem. Open extension is exact and preserves coproducts; closed direct image is exact and has an exceptional right adjoint by recollement, so it also preserves coproducts. Minimality of the weak Serre coproduct classes transfers these classes along each branch functor.

The open unit and closed counit identify the two restrictions of the localization maps. Disjoint support vanishing and exact joint zero-detection give the localization short exact sequence. Restriction of coefficients is exact and commutes with the open and closed branch functors, so induction on the finite tree and extension closure reconstruct the root from Step 2. Transport through the specified coefficient isomorphism. Empty strata and zero ranks are included.

proof_origin.place: Finite coefficient basis, lisse finite descent, scalar-unit coproduct, finite open-closed induction.
